naive_model.formula: L_p = C0 * ln(p) / p,  omega_p = 2*pi / ln(p)
naive_model.supremum_formula: sup at p=2: pi * C0 = pi * ln(10)
naive_model.physical_cause: The ln(p) factor in L_p and omega_p cancel exactly, leaving 2*pi*C0/p. At p=2 this equals pi*ln(10) ~ 7.23. The naive coupling overestimates dissipation strength by a factor of 2*pi relative to the physical channel bandwidth.

renormalized_model.physical_justification: Rescaling alpha = 1/(2*pi) removes the spurious 2*pi factor from the coupling-frequency product. The renormalized product L_p * omega_p = 1/p is monotonically decreasing, bounded by 1/2 at p=2, satisfying SlopeUB < 1 - delta_crit = 0.83.
